♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 YASOHOTSE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions ifite **Your script** na **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, hamwe na **Flex Studio (Beta)** ibanza gukururwa, hanyuma ikakubaza mbere yo kwishyiraho.

*(Yishyire hejuru y'iyo ufite ubu, hanyuma wongere utangize After Effects rimwe.)*

♦️ **Igishya: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Imiterere ya **Map desk**, gushakisha ahantu nta murandasi, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route n'ibindi), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, imiterere y'amakarita y'ubuntu na **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ibikoresho byayo by'inyongera (guhuza ako kanya, imiterere, ibirango, 3D, Finalize) ubu bifunguka koko imbere muri After Effects.

♦️ **Ibishya muri AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (mu gicu, ikoresha kredi za Flex AI) ni yo moteri isabwa, yatoranyijwe rimwe kuri bose. Ongera uhitemo Whisper kugira ngo ukore ibisobanuro byanditse ku buntu kuri mudasobwa yawe (Translate To ikenera Whisper). Iyo seriveri ihuze, ubona umwanya wawe ku murongo.
* **Your script**: ibisobanuro bifata imyandikire n'amagambo byayo ahantu hose wavugiye ayo magambo.
* Ibisohoka bya **Editable template**: ibisobanuro biba ibyiciro (layers) bya template uhindurira imiterere muri Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Nta kintu cyatoranyijwe kandi Source media irimo ubusa? Igutangira **composition yose**. Amajwi amwe yongera gukoresha inyandiko-mvugo yayo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ibanza gukurura porogaramu, hanyuma ikabaza **Install / Not now**.
* Porogaramu (2.0.0-beta.2): aho gukorera **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, utubuto tw'ibikoresho nk'utwa After Effects, clips zifunguka ako kanya, kandi OPEN ikora no kuri precomps n'ibyiciro byo guhindura (adjustment layers).

♦️ **Byakosowe**
* Ingaruka z'insanganyamatsiko zari zabuze kuri mudasobwa nyinshi za Windows zagarutse (zoroheje iyo ingaruka z'animasiyo za Windows zizimye).

♦️ **Aho uherereye, ku bushake, mu kurinda uruhushya**
* Tubaza rimwe gusa, kandi ni ku bushake: **No thanks** ituma byose bikomeza gukora. Bihindure muri **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Bibikwa amezi 12, ntibigurishwa na rimwe, kandi ntibisangizwa abandi keretse aho amategeko abisaba.

♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 YASOHOTSE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack yimukiye muri AutoCaptions** ifite imiterere kuri buri jambo, imitondekere, imigendere n'amajwi. **UN-NEST** n'uburyo bwo kuvanga (blend modes) bikora kuri Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ni ugukanda rimwe, kandi **Flex Studio (Beta)** ifungura clip yawe uhereye kuri panel.

*(Yishyire hejuru y'iyo ufite ubu, hanyuma wongere utangize Premiere Pro rimwe.)*

♦️ **Igishya: Ibisobanuro bigenda muri AutoCaptions**
* **Imiterere y'ijambo**: ha ijambo iryo ari ryo ryose amabara yaryo, imyandikire (font) yaryo n'isura ya Flat, Shine cyangwa Glow.
* **Imitondekere y'imirongo**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside na Line.
* **Imigendere kuri buri jambo** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake n'ibindi) hamwe n'igaragazabanza, wongeyeho amajwi ya **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Imiterere y'amagambo n'imigendere bikenera ibisohoka bya **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (mu gicu, ikoresha kredi za Flex AI) ubu ni yo moteri isabwa, yatoranyijwe rimwe kuri bose; hitamo moteri ya Whisper kugira ngo ukore ibisobanuro nta murandasi kandi ku buntu.
* **Your script** (uburyo bwa Captions): ibisobanuro bifata amagambo yayo aho wavugiye ayo magambo.
* Nta kintu cyatoranyijwe (ikarita ya Source irimo ubusa), igutangira **umurongo w'igihe wose**; ibisobanuro bibikwa iruhande rw'umushinga wawe.

♦️ **Igishya: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** ikurikirana clip muri porogaramu; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** isubiza ibyakurikiranywe. Ntiyashyizweho? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** irayikurura, hanyuma ikabaza **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Ibyahindutse**
* **AUTO CUT** isesengura clip yatoranyijwe ikanayikata ukanze rimwe. **Retakes** ifata interuro zongeye gutangirwa.
* **Audio Studio** igizwe n'udusanduku dutandatu tw'imbere (sub-tabs). **Library** ubu iba muri Nest Saver.

♦️ **Byakosowe**
* **UN-NEST** kuri Premiere 26.5 (yangaga nest zose), n'uburyo bwo kuvanga nka Screen bwasubiraga kuri Normal (Premiere mu Cyongereza).
* Akarango gatukura ka **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, igaragazabanza ry'umukara rya Caption Stack, n'ingaruka z'insanganyamatsiko zari zabuze kuri mudasobwa nyinshi za Windows.

♦️ **Aho uherereye, ku bushake, mu kurinda uruhushya**
* Tubaza rimwe gusa, kandi ni ku bushake: **No thanks** ituma byose bikomeza gukora. Bihindure muri **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Bibikwa amezi 12, ntibigurishwa na rimwe, kandi ntibisangizwa abandi keretse aho amategeko abisaba.
